halfB_cadRollPostcondition.caveatALoadBearingOne: This is the POST-BAKE condition evaluated BEFORE the re-bake. The baked side is therefore the PRE-EXISTING snapshots (baked before today's certified load), so a PASS proves the gate would not REFUSE -- it does NOT prove the card serves certified values. The re-bake is still what refreshes the served dollars; the gate only checks presence, never freshness. Staging's history is the sharp edge here: after P-177's bake fix, the OLD (bare-account) expectation went RED at 146/500 (29.2%) on Hays staging, which is exactly why the gate was re-shaped to sample nodes. A green today does not pre-empt a red after the re-bake.
